criteria.requirement: Repair Function.get_sql/get_function_sql so caller serialization context, particularly parameter collectors, reaches each argument and nested function while preserving namespace, dialect, quote, schema and alias semantics. Normalize explicitly controlled with_alias/subquery options to prevent duplicate keyword errors. Preserve get_special_params_sql extension behavior, aggregate FILTER collection order and plain literals. Demonstrate real bound SQLite execution and ordered Qmark/Named collections; never interpolate bound user values.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
